verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own background automations: auto-transfer rules that split each deposit by dollar amount or percentage, sweeps of idle cash into savings, recurring invoices with automatic follow-up, and automatic sync to accounting software. These are fixed rule types rather than a general or AI-driven automation builder, and a community user notes that external payments still have to be executed manually. Missing for 10: a general-purpose or agentic automation builder, autonomous execution of external payments, and independent hands-on corroboration of reliability beyond money partitioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate transfers from one to multiple accounts using dollar amounts or percentages.
Relay’s auto-transfer rules make it easy by moving your excess cash out of operating accounts and into savings for you.
sync everything to your accounting software automatically
Relay does a good job of automatically partitioning money, though you still need to manually execute external payments.
